title.narrative: Governance Reform and Accountability Transformation (GREAT) Project

description.narrative: The project will support the government of Liberia to enhance access to selected digitally-provided public services, raise tax revenues, and improve the openness of accountability institutions.

To enhance access to selected digitally provided public services, raise tax revenues, and improve the openness of accountability institutions. The PDO will be achieved by strengthening the use of country systems and sustainably building the capacity of civil servants to implement programs of reform.
